research_question: Can causal top-of-book quoted-volume imbalance confirm the direction of the previously near-neutral M5 BB/KC volatility-release source strongly enough to improve frozen 30-second executable persistence while preserving usable event supply?

rationale.vce_clue: R037-VCE-C04_BBKC_RELEASE_MOM12 produced 27 accepted entries and +$0.71 direct source net on Stage-A, but only -$0.13 integrated net delta; preserve source-default M5 release grammar unchanged.
rationale.qim_clue: R037-QIM-v1 showed ~0.56-0.57 next-mid/250ms directional accuracy at frozen |I| thresholds but failed when treated as a standalone high-frequency entry source because costs overwhelmed tiny moves.
rationale.synthesis: Use QIM only as a causal confirmation filter at a larger completed volatility-release event; do not create entries from QIM alone.

source_basis.role: frozen M5 BB20/2.0 inside KC EMA20/1.5ATR20 squeeze -> release -> close beyond KC; C04 requires 12-bar close momentum alignment.

baseline.rule: Exact R037-VCE-C04 M5 BB/KC release + MOM12 proposal grammar, no QI gate.
baseline.role: implementation/control fingerprint only; not a new candidate

profiles.rule: At first executable tick after completed VCE-C04 signal bar, require |I|>=0.25 and sign(I)==VCE direction.
At first executable tick after completed VCE-C04 signal bar, require |I|>=0.50 and sign(I)==VCE direction.
At first executable tick after completed VCE-C04 signal bar, require |I|>=0.75 and sign(I)==VCE direction.

event_semantics.vce: Completed M5 bars only; prior bar squeezed, current bar released, current close beyond current KC, 12-bar close displacement agrees.
event_semantics.qim: Current canonical Dukascopy best-bid/ask quoted volumes only at the first executable tick; no forward volume, no persistence/lookahead.
event_semantics.entry: If profile gate passes, enter on that same first executable tick under P75 quote-side execution.

gate.advance_if: At least one fixed QI-confirmed lane satisfies all gates unchanged.
gate.ranking: direct net USD, then official wins, then trades; no profile creation after result.
gate.no_micro_sample_rule: A positive lane with <10 trades or <5 distinct days is a clue only and cannot advance.

anti_overfit: No QI threshold interpolation or new threshold after result.
No parent-integration interpretation until a direct Stage-A lane passes.
